source: 1309 知更鸟 终结技 (skill 130903, Ultra/Support) 第一句: 「知更鸟进入【协奏】状态，使除自身以外的队友立即行动。」 param Lv10 = [0.228, 90, 200, 1.2, 1, 1.5]
note:
Only the first sentence. ⚠ `other_allies` is the whole reason that word exists: 「除自身以外」 is not `all_allies` (302 不老者的仙舟's 「我方全体」 does include the wearer, and that is pinned), and no condition can say it -- conditions filter rules, not the units an effect reaches. ⚠ `actor == self` is load-bearing: ULT_CAST reaches every character's table. ⚠ `percent: 1.0` = 立即行动 (all of the remaining wait). ⚠ NOT authored from the same ultimate (2026-09-28 复核：**每一句的卡点都定位到了具体能力**，不是「整段太难」):
• **今天写得出**：`0.228 × 她的攻击力 + 200` 是 **#1/#3**、附加伤害是 **#4**、固定暴击是 **#5/#6**（都是同一行 param 的列），倒计时的速度是 **#2 = 90** —— 词都齐了（`MODIFY_ATTR` + `scale: self_attr:ATTACK`、`DAMAGE` + `damage_param: 3`、`crit_rate: 1` + `crit_damage: 1.5`、`START_COUNTDOWN speed: 90`、`COUNTDOWN_TURN`、`APPLY_BUFF`/`REMOVE_STATE`/`EXTRA_TURN`）。
• ⚠ **卡住的三件，而且是一个整体**：③ 我方全体攻击力提高与 ⑤ 免疫控制类都是**跟着【协奏】的时长走**的（时长由倒计时定义，不是回合数），而引擎能**按名字移除的只有「状态」**（`REMOVE_STATE` → `BuffManager.removeState(name)`，见 `applyState` 的注释：`APPLY_BUFF` 造的是裸 `StateBuff`），**属性修饰（`StatModifierBuff`）没有名字、也没有按名移除的 op** —— 于是这两个增益只能写成 `permanent`，永远不撤下（一个**没有任何症状**的持续错误）；⑦「【协奏】状态结束前**不会进入自己的回合**且无法行动」则需要「这个单位暂时不轮到自己」（语料 22 处 / 11 文件，`cannot_act` 一类），而它正是**倒计时代替她行动**的另一半。
• ⚠ **为什么不能「先写一半」**：只写 ①【协奏】状态 + ④ 附加伤害、不写 ⑥/⑦ 的话，状态**永不结束**（附加伤害会永远跟着每次友方攻击），只写 ⑥ 倒计时、不写 ⑦ 的话她**自己还会照常轮到自己**（比文档多一整套自己的回合）—— 两种都是「看起来写完了」的错模型，所以整组登记。
• **下一步的能力**（按读者量排序）：i. **给修饰命名 + 按名移除**（本句 ③⑤ 的读者，也是「状态型属性增益」这一族的通用缺口）；ii. **不进入自己回合**（22 处 / 11 文件）；之后这整段就能一次写完。

source: 1309 知更鸟 talent (skill 130904) / character doc line 147
note: Doc text: 「…且我方目标攻击敌方目标后，知更鸟额外为自身恢复2点能量。」 A FLAT 2 per attack (no per_target), unlike Tribbie's per-hit 1.5. 'actor != self' encodes 「我方目标」, i.e. allies but not Robin herself. E0 value.

source: 1309 知更鸟 trace 华彩花腔
note: Doc text: 「战斗开始时，自身行动提前25%。」 Nothing new is needed for this one: BATTLE_START fires from startBattle() AFTER the queue was initialized in the constructor (so the action bar already holds everyone and there is a wait to shorten), and ADVANCE skips a fraction of the target's REMAINING wait, defaulting to the rule's owner -- so this pulls Robin forward and leaves the other three alone. E0 value (params [0.25]); the test compares her against the same character with an emptied table, because 'a quarter of the remaining wait' is not the same number as 'a quarter of the round'.

source: 1309 知更鸟 trace 模进乐段
note: Doc text: 「施放战技时额外恢复5点能量。」 SKILL_CAST is broadcast to the whole side (SkillExecutor.broadcastSkillCast, actor = the caster), which is what makes the condition load-bearing rather than decorative: without `actor == self`, every ally's skill would pay Robin 5 energy too. The doc sentence names no subject other than the character herself, the same reading as the other two traces -- and the split from ULT_CAST is already made at the emitter, so her ultimate does not double-dip here. E0 value (params [5]).

source: 1309 知更鸟 终结技 千音迭奏，群星赋格 (skill 130903) ①「知更鸟进入【协奏】状态」+ ⑥「行动序列上出现【协奏】倒计时…倒计时固定拥有 90 点速度」 param Lv10 = [0.228, 90, 200, 1.2, 1, 1.5] → #2 = 90
note: Two of the seven clauses, together because they are the two halves of one timeline: the state begins here and ends at the countdown's turn (the last rule below), which is why its duration cannot be a `turns` count -- the countdown is a real unit on the action order (M-49), so advances, delays and breaks move it exactly as they move everybody else. ⚠ `suspendsTurns: true` is clause ⑦ 「【协奏】状态结束前不会进入自己的回合且无法行动」 riding on the state: she is not in the order while it lasts, and the countdown acts in her place. ⚠ Deliberately not a control -- a control would still let her turns arrive (and her DOTs tick); see `AbstractBuff.isSuspendsTurns()`. ⚠ `permanent: true` is not forever: it means no turn count, and the end is stated by the countdown rule, which is the honest spelling of a duration decided by the action bar. ⚠ `speed: 90` is #2 of this skill's own row.

source: 1309 知更鸟 终结技 ③「处于【协奏】状态时，我方全体攻击力提高，提高数值等同于知更鸟攻击力的 22.80%+200 点」+ ⑤「处于【协奏】状态时，知更鸟免疫控制类负面状态」 param Lv10 = [0.228, 90, 200, 1.2, 1, 1.5] → #1 = 0.228, #3 = 200
note: Clauses ③ and ⑤, the two effects that last as long as the state does. ⚠ Both carry `buff: 协奏` (2026-09-28), which is what makes that duration expressible at all: removal by name used to reach only states, so a modifier like this could only be written `permanent` -- a boost that never comes off, i.e. a wrong number with no symptom. Naming it means the countdown-turn rule's single `REMOVE_STATE 协奏` takes the state, the ATK boost AND the immunity off together. ⚠ ③ is a derived magnitude (22.8% of her ATK plus the flat 200), read when she casts and then frozen. ⚠ `all_allies` includes her (「我方全体」 says so); ② 「除自身以外」 is the ADVANCE rule above, a different sentence with a different selector. ⚠ `percent: 1.0` on the resistance is immunity -- the same mechanic at full strength.

source: 1309 知更鸟 终结技 ④「处于【协奏】状态时…我方目标每次施放攻击后，知更鸟会额外造成1次等同于其自身 120% 攻击力的物理属性附加伤害，该伤害暴击率固定为 100%，暴击伤害固定为 150%。」 param Lv10 = [0.228, 90, 200, 1.2, 1, 1.5] → #4 = 1.2（倍率）、#5 = 1（固定暴击率）、#6 = 1.5（固定暴伤）
note: Clause ④, the rider that makes 【协奏】 a damage window. ⚠ Three numbers, all from the skill's own row: the multiplier is #4 (`damageParam: 3`, 1.2 = 120%), and the crit comes from #5/#6 -- `critRate: 1` (fixed 100%, i.e. no roll) plus `critDamage: 1.5`. ⚠ The physical element and the single-target shape come from 130903's own data. ⚠ `self has_state 协奏` is what makes it 「处于【协奏】状态时…」; ⚠ `actor != self` + `hit_count > 0` mirror her talent's own reading of 「我方目标…攻击敌方目标后」 -- and since ⑦ keeps her out of the order, her own attack cannot arrive while this is live anyway. ⚠ `target: target` is the unit the triggering attack hit (「额外造成1次」 is the same victim). ⚠ Crit damage is stated the way the panel states it (1.5 = 150%), so the settled multiplier is ×2.5.

source: 1309 知更鸟 终结技 ⑥「…倒计时回合开始时知更鸟退出【协奏】状态并立即行动」
note: Clause ⑥, the end of the timeline: 「倒计时回合开始时知更鸟退出【协奏】状态并立即行动」. ⚠ One `REMOVE_STATE 协奏` ends the whole thing, because the state and both of its effects carry that same name (see the ③⑤ rule above) -- including the `suspendsTurns` flag, which rides on the state itself, so her turns come back with no second switch to remember. ⚠ Its target is `all_allies`, not `self`, and that is the whole point: the STATE lives on her while its named effects sit on every ally, so removing it from her alone would leave the party ATK boost behind forever (measured: the first version did exactly that, and the test that caught it is `RobinConcertoTest.theCountdownTurnEndsEverythingAtOnce`). ⚠ `EXTRA_TURN` is 「立即行动」, granted after the removal so she really takes the turn the state was holding back. ⚠ `self has_state 协奏` on the rule is the gate: 「…知更鸟退出」 (her own state ends) and it keeps this rule from answering somebody else's countdown. ⚠ The honest limitation: the engine has no `countdown == mine` identity term, so the narrowing is by state rather than by unit -- with one countdown in the fight (today's content) they are the same thing, and a second countdown-owner would need that term.
